x-goodarthlywd:7707606909154: The Poplock aligns with a Good Art tradition of not leaving well enough alone. Our patented pill-shaped clasp may look familiar but it's mechanism is novel. Inside hides a spring loaded plunger that holds the last ball in place. Pop the ball into the jaws and you're good to go. To remove it, move the chain perpendicular and pull to open up. The actions make a snappy sound. The old version worked fine, this one works fun. Every time. Comes standard at 9", trim to size with a scissors. Go slowly, the balls come off easier then they go back on. Send the spare balls back to us for a sticker pack. Sterling silver. Made by hand in our foundry in Los Angeles.
x-goodarthlywd:8291078275298: It's great making something wholly original, but that doesn't happen often. Certain things just work well.
